_comment: Dry-run output for one listing (derived from listing-quality-row.json). This is what the skill emits for human approval BEFORE anything is written to TikTok. `title`/`description` carry current vs proposed; `issues_addressed` ties each change to the TikTok diagnosis result that drove it; `image_checklist` is merchant action (never auto-applied); `expected` is the tier after the title+description writes land. Nothing here is written until a reviewer approves AND the Edit Product apply path exists.

title.proposed: Acme Cotton Midi Dress for Women — Breathable A-Line Summer Dress, Machine Washable

issues_addressed.how_to_solve: Names must be at least 40 characters long.

description.proposed_html:
Stay cool and effortlessly put-together in the Acme Cotton Midi Dress. Cut from breathable cotton in a flattering A-line silhouette, it carries you from the office to the weekend.

  • Breathable cotton — soft, lightweight fabric for all-day comfort in warm weather.
  • A-line midi length — a flattering cut that suits every body shape.
  • Machine washable — easy care; wash cold and hang to dry.
  • Everyday to occasion — dress it up or down with a jacket or sandals.

issues_addressed.how_to_solve: Add a detailed description of at least 300 characters covering materials, fit and care.

fact_sources: mapped SKU.io product attributes (product 51234): material=Cotton, fit=A-line, care=Machine washable

image_checklist.how_to_solve: Add more images and make the first image a product shot on a plain white background.
image_checklist.merchant_action: Add images to reach TikTok's minimum (aim for 5+). Make the FIRST image a clean product shot on a plain white background. This cannot be auto-generated — merchant to supply.

after_title_description_writes.note: Title and description issues resolved. The IMAGE issue remains until the merchant acts on the checklist; full GOOD depends on it.

apply.blocked_on: Edit Product API not yet implemented in Modules/TikTokShop (see INSTRUCTIONS.md > API availability).
